title: Goblin King Dronan event
summary: Follow Dronan's timed goblin contest and find the hidden prize carrier.
overview: Dronan's arrival begins a 30-minute contest. Goblin seekers spread through Frontier Mountains while announcements lead into the hiding stage.
Eight minutes after the King spawns, four goblin hiders appear across the zone. One receives the quest prize; search the hiders before the contest ends.

phases.label: Seekers disperse
phases.description: Five seekers appear immediately, with further groups created on a 45-second timer.

phases.label: Find the hidden goblin
phases.description: Four hiders are created and one receives the prize.

phases.label: Contest ends
phases.description: The King, seekers, hiders and associated named goblins are removed.

notes: Approved row E126. Quest source reviewed; live encounter behavior and loaded database spell/loot data have not been verified.
The reviewed encounter registers behavior but does not establish how the King is initially made available; verify the current launcher or database spawn.
The seeker timer stops after its round counter passes ten but still executes the spawn block on that callback; no exact total wave count is promised.
